findings.rule: REVIEW.md Framework rules: 'Flag when the change has made CLAUDE.md outdated'; REVIEW.md: second occurrence of the same finding proposes a 'Things Claude gets wrong' entry
findings.summary: sample_pkg gains a new public function (mean) but CLAUDE.md's Layout entries for sample_pkg/calc.py (line 22) and sample_pkg/__init__.py (line 23) still list only add, divide and percent, so the guardrail file is now outdated about the package's public API; this is the same pattern flagged in change 0001's review (evidence/../0001-.../evidence/review-findings.json, CLAUDE.md:22) for percent, so it is a second occurrence and warrants a one-line 'Things Claude gets wrong' entry proposed for the owner (e.g. "New public functions in sample_pkg/calc.py routinely leave CLAUDE.md's Layout/Commands sections outdated until the owner applies the review's proposed line by hand").
